title: Cherry-Pick Numbered Changes from Comparison Report
description:
You are helping a researcher selectively apply changes from a revised paper. Use the document comparison tool to compare paper_v1.tex and paper_v2.tex, then apply ONLY the following specific numbered changes (as reported by the tool):

Apply changes: 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 29, 36, 50, 51, 52, 53, 63, 64, 65, 71, 72, 73, 75, 76

These are the change numbers as reported by `doccompare compare` (not the block IDs).

For 'added' changes, insert the new content in the appropriate location.
For 'modified' changes, replace the v1 block with the v2 version.
For 'deleted' changes, remove the block.

All other changes should NOT be applied - keep the v1 version for everything else.

You have access to a document comparison tool at: TOOL_PATH/doccompare.py
The original file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v1.tex
The revised file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v2.tex

Write the result to: WORK_DIR/output.tex
notes: This tests the agent's ability to work directly with the tool's output format and apply a specific subset of numbered changes. The challenge is that some changes are insertions that need to go in the right place, and the selected set is deliberately non-contiguous.
